root_cause.message: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space after retaining byte arrays in static list memory leak

expected.business_impact: /profile/export production business path is affected by memory_leak

primary_evidence.metric: Metric jvm.memory.heap.used.percent breaches threshold on profile-service.

non_root_noise: profile-cache write latency is below threshold and follows the memory pressure
background audit-service warning is outside the affected call path
noise-service metric is normal and outside the affected call path
